panels.description: Colorado pilot, day. A recovery belt splits selected PET and polyolefin toward Project 863 while rejected mixed material diverts into a marked bin. Include wet concrete, drains, and maintenance clutter. Leave upper-left for the location caption and lower corners for two labels.

A compact Project 863 reactor stands beside an insulated cold-active enzyme bioreactor. Pipes, temperature controls, flow meters, and service labels make the process physical. Leave the top for a caption.
Recovered hydrocarbon feedstock exits into a sealed container. Residual solids sit in a separate drum beside an active emissions monitor. Leave upper-left for a caption.
A monitoring wall shows water use, grid demand, emissions, and finite throughput beside working machinery. Leave upper-right for Croft's recorded dialogue.
